text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.We will move on to the seventh period of Unit 1.The topic today is learning by doing.By the end of this lesson, you are expected to 1.Interpret the text structure and main features of the example writing and clarify the writing requirements 2.Combine learning experiences to get prepared for supporting details 3.Use personal experiences to support ideas and complete the writing task according to online submission requirements First, please make sure you've got your textbook and worksheet ready.Boys and girls, how do you understand learning by doing?In my view, it means people learn something by hands-on practice.What experience can be related to learning by doing?In the previous lessons, we have learned many such examples.For instance, Yang Darwin acquired a nickname of gas because he used to help his brother with experiments in making gases and compounds in their laboratory.Well, I'm sure you have a general idea about learning by doing now.Then, boys and girls, please turn to page 16.We can see that Li Jing, who works for the Students' Union, is organizing an event themed learning by doing for students in his school and sister school in Singapore.Here is a short article he is going to post on the event website.Please read it and find the general statement.The supporting details and the concluding sentence.You're right.The general statement of the article is.The idea of learning by doing proved effective in one of the most unforgettable courses I took in the art club at school.The supporting details are.From to my surprise to without it collapsing.And this course has given us useful exposure to design principles because it actively engages us in the learning process.Is the concluding sentence.In the body part, the writer uses personal experiences as supporting details.So we can see personal experiences and observations are often used to support a writer's statements.They can be the writer's own or someone else's experiences.Well expressed personal experiences can help to convince readers.And I like it to remind readers of their own experiences.To make you understand better, let's look at these two sentences.Which one is more convincing, why?I agree with you.Sentence A is obviously more convincing.In sentence A, the writer uses more specific details.These interesting personal experiences can help to convince us and are more likely to remind us of our own experiences.In our daily life, there are a lot of our personal experiences.In the viewing, we have learned that the 93-year-old man practices playing the piano despite his old age.His teacher Stephanie Jacob says he is one of her hardest-working students, practicing with her 45 minutes every two weeks, then back to his apartment to practice some more.Today, you will write an article to be published on the website, sharing your personal experiences of learning by doing.First, please write a general statement of your own about learning by doing.Here is one example for your reference on page 16 in the textbook.The idea of learning by doing is becoming increasingly appealing to high school students.Please write your general statement.Here is an example from Kevin.The idea of learning by doing applies to my English learning.This is a general statement.Now, please list some details that can support your general statement.These are the details listed by Kevin.Communicating with native speakers.Listening to English news.Reading English classics.To make the article complete, we need a concluding sentence.Dear students, we will have two minutes to write a concluding sentence.Where, Kevin's concluding sentence is My English has greatly improved because I have engaged myself in the learning process.Now, it's time for us to write a complete article.You are required to organize your personal experiences to support the general statement by referring to the example writing.Read the article in 90 to 110 words.Read the example writing again before proceeding with the writing task.Now you will have eight minutes to finish the article.中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶對,我確定你的文章操作完成了。這裡是Karen的文章以你的參考。我學習中文的學習方法的主要目標是我的英學。在我的日常生活中,我总是找到有机会与网络与网友交流的机会。每次我遇到一个网友,我都不会担心与他交流。另外,我每天都会听英语新闻,因此我能够练习我的听识,并且把自己向真正的英语表达。更多的,我经常读英语经典课,以欣赏英语文学。因此,我的英语进步了很多,因为我在学习过程中与自己互动。今天我们学习了什么呢?我们应该在最初写下一个明确的总结。然后,我们应该利用个人的经历作为支援详细,去证明读者,因为个人的经历比较容易提醒读者自己的经历。另外,当我们写书时,我们应该利用个人的词汇和个人的写法。最后,不要忘记写下一个强烈的总结词。今天就这样了,接下来的计划。刷《学习与做》的文章,有90至110词,代表写下的例子,在15页上。现在是你们与教练和同学们互动的时间。与他们一起学习的经验分享。感谢您的观看。
